title: Chader dikha dikha ke
body:
Chader na kafan hai dur watan hai
Be Parda behan hathon mai rasan
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye zainab haye haye bazaar
<<MINI>>
Chader na kafan hai dur watan hai
Be Parda behan hathon mai rasan
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas ki behan ko shami rula rahe hain
Chader dhika dhika ke rasta bana rahi hain
Bint e Ali ka fiza kante hata hata ke
Pardes mai kisi per aesa na waqt ai
<<DIVIDER>>
Na mahramon mai koi yun be rida na jai
Karte hain yeh duain ahl e haram ke bache
Jholi utha utha ke
Bhai behan ki ankhein nam hoti jarahi hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Bint e Ali ki sansein kam hoti jarahi hain
Khanjar chala raha hai Zainab ke dil pe zalim
Khanjar dhika dhika ke
Ik bachi keh rahi hai ao madad ko baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Dadi ki tarha mai bhi ab ho gayi zaeefa
Zakhmi kiya hai pehlu,naqay se zalimon ne
Mujh ko gira gira ke
Parde mai bhi jo bibi chalti na thi ziyada
<<DIVIDER>>
Pardes mai ab un par aya hai waqt kesa
Layein hain shaam wale un shah zadiyon ko
Paidal chala chala ke
Wo shamiyon ke tane, wo muskurate chehre
<<DIVIDER>>
Be parda sath apne bint e Ali ko le ke
Sajjad kese bholein us bheer se guzarna
Nazrein jhuka jhuka ke
Jate hain jis taraf bhi ahl e haram khule sar
<<DIVIDER>>
Khati hain pehle durra khati hain pehle phattar
Apne lahoo mai tar hain Zehra ki betiyon ko
Fizza bacha bacha ke
Zakhmo ki wo taqalum tadad jante hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Mehdi ko bhi khabar hai sajjad jante hai
Maare hain kis ne kitne Haider ki ladli ko
Pathar utha utha ke
